steps.js: for (let i=0;i<80;i++){ if (document.querySelector('.hub-anchors-st')) break; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); } const bs=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].filter(b=>/再生成/.test(b.innerText+(b.title||''))); const where=bs.map(b=>{ const sec=b.closest('section, [class*=hub-look], [class*=hub-face], [class*=hub-item], [class*=card]'); return (sec?.className||'').toString().split(' ')[0]; }); const count={}; where.forEach(w=>count[w]=(count[w]||0)+1); return {total:bs.length, byContainer:count, sampleTitles:bs.slice(0,3).map(b=>(b.title||'').slice(0,40))};

steps.clickAt: (() => { const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>/再生成/.test(b.innerText+(b.title||'')) && b.getBoundingClientRect().width>0); if(!b) return [null,null]; b.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); const r=b.getBoundingClientRect(); return [r.x+r.width/2,r.y+r.height/2]; })()
